newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Costello to hold tax briefing.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Costello to hold tax briefing.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello will hold a briefing at 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT) on Wednesday on the government's response to the recent High Court ruling on state taxes, his office said.
The news conference will be in Sydney.
In a landmark four to three decision, the full bench of the court on Tuesday outlawed lucrative state taxes on tobacco, alcohol and petrol.
Australia's six states and two territories have asked the national government to levy the taxes -- worth about A$5 billion a year -- on their behalf and return the money to them.
Costello said on Tuesday the government was ready to help.
